final: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry COLLATE BINARY JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation COLLATE BINARY), grouped AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift FROM matched GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM matched) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_modindex), AVG(g.avg_phaseshift), AVG(g.avg_modindex - o.avg_modindex) FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_modindex IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_modindex > o.avg_modindex GROUP BY g.weathprofile
